description: This file contains SCSS styles defining icon animations, rotations, mirroring effects, and related styling rules, specifically for Font Awesome extras.

methods.name: icon-spin
methods.description: Defines the spinning animation for icons with infinite duration and linear timing.

methods.name: icon-rotate-90
methods.description: Applies a 90-degree rotation to icons using pseudo-element styling.

methods.name: icon-rotate-180
methods.description: Applies a 180-degree rotation to icons using pseudo-element styling.

methods.name: icon-rotate-270
methods.description: Applies a 270-degree rotation to icons using pseudo-element styling.

methods.name: icon-flip-horizontal
methods.description: Flips icons horizontally using CSS scale transformation.

methods.name: icon-flip-vertical
methods.description: Flips icons vertically using CSS scale transformation.
